vector_memory.semantic_summary: This component defines the IProject interface, serving as a foundational contract for any project entity within the editor system. It standardizes the structure required for project data, mandating a unique ID and the associated scene file path. It also allows for optional metadata like a name and configuration data, making it central to project state management across the application.

graph_nodes.label: Interface
graph_nodes.name: IProject
graph_nodes.signature: interface IProject { id: string; scene: string; name?:string; config: any; }
